items.title: CryoID2: deep learning-enhanced identification of protein and RNA from cryoEM maps
items.abstract_or_text: Identifying the molecular components of cryoEM/cryoET maps of endogenous or poorly characterized complexes remains a major bottleneck. CryoID2 addresses this by integrating deep learning-based feature prediction with sequence prioritization and structural evaluation. Three 3D U-Nets extract structure classes, key-atom positions, and reduced residue/nucleotide types from the input map. These predictions support backbone tracing and the generation of short sequence queries that rank candidates from a user-supplied pool-using BLASTp for proteins and a maximin strategy for RNA. Corresponding PDB or AlphaFold models are then retrieved, rigidly fitted using predicted features and experimental density, and ranked by map agreement. Module-level tests show high-recall feature prediction and resolution-dependent atom clustering, while a 52-case benchmark recovers near-reference fitting quality. In practice, cryoID2 correctly identified PfA-M17 from a 166-protein mass-spectrometry pool and the unannotated Ca-raiA RNA from a genome-derived non-coding sequence set, demonstrating a unified sequence-plus-structure route to molecular identification in cryoEM maps.
items.summary_zh: CryoID2 用 3D U-Net 预测 cryoEM 图中的结构特征，再结合序列检索和结构拟合识别蛋白质与 RNA。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 52 个案例的基准中评估，并在蛋白质池和基因组来源非编码序列中完成实证识别，连接了冷冻电镜密度、序列和结构证据。
items.abstract_zh: 识别内源性或表征不足复合物的 cryoEM/cryoET 图中的分子组分，仍是一个主要瓶颈。CryoID2 通过整合基于深度学习的特征预测、序列优先级排序和结构评估来解决这一问题。三个 3D U-Net 从输入图中提取结构类别、关键原子位置以及简化的残基/核苷酸类型。这些预测支持主链追踪，并生成短序列查询，从用户提供的候选池中进行排序——蛋白质使用 BLASTp，RNA 使用 maximin 策略。随后检索相应的 PDB 或 AlphaFold 模型，根据预测特征和实验密度进行刚性拟合，并按照与图的匹配程度排序。模块级测试显示，特征预测具有高召回率，原子聚类具有分辨率依赖性；在包含 52 个案例的基准中，CryoID2 恢复了接近参考结果的拟合质量。在实际应用中，CryoID2 从包含 166 个蛋白质的质谱候选池中正确识别出 PfA-M17，并从基因组来源的非编码序列集合中正确识别出未注释的 Ca-raiA RNA，展示了在 cryoEM 图中通过序列加结构路径进行分子识别的统一方法。
items.author_line: Xu, Q., Yu, X., Wu, L., Feng, S., Zhou, Z. H.

items.title: ALBI: LLM-Guided Inductive Logic Programming via Iterative Generate-Test-Constrain Refineme
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce ALBI (Agent for Learning By Induction), a neuro-symbolic ILP framework that replaces the ASP-based hypothesis generator in the Learning from Failures (LFF) paradigm with a Large Language Model (LLM), while retaining SWI-Prolog as a formal verifier. ALBI implements an iterative generate-test-constrain loop: the LLM proposes candidate hypotheses from structured prompts; Prolog tests each candidate; and diagnostic feedback drives refinement. We further introduce semantic anonymization, a metamorphic testing methodology, to distinguish structural symbolic induction from surface-level pattern matching on predicate names. Experiments on 30 standard ILP benchmarks show that ALBI achieves 100% success across three frontier LLMs (Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.4 Pro, Claude Opus 4.6), matching Popper while requiring only 1.4-1.7 iterations on average. Under anonymization, all models maintain 100% success with a moderate iteration increase (1.36-1.67 times), providing evidence of robust symbolic reasoning.
items.summary_zh: ALBI 用大语言模型提出归纳逻辑程序候选，再由 SWI-Prolog 形式验证器测试并根据诊断反馈迭代修正；在30个标准 ILP 基准上，三种模型均达到100%成功率，并通过语义匿名化测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把 LLM 的候选生成与可执行的符号验证闭环结合，任务、验证器和变形测试都较清晰，可检验模型是否真正利用了谓词结构。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 ALBI（Agent for Learning By Induction），一种神经符号归纳逻辑编程（ILP）框架：它在 Learning from Failures（LFF）范式中用大型语言模型（LLM）替代基于 ASP 的假设生成器，同时保留 SWI-Prolog 作为形式验证器。ALBI 实现了迭代式的生成—测试—约束循环：LLM 根据结构化提示提出候选假设；Prolog 测试每个候选；诊断反馈驱动后续修正。我们还引入语义匿名化这一变形测试方法，用于区分结构性的符号归纳与仅依赖谓词名称表面模式的匹配。在30个标准 ILP 基准上的实验表明，ALBI 在三种前沿 LLM（Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT 5.4 Pro、Claude Opus 4.6）上均达到100%的成功率，与 Popper 相当，平均仅需1.4–1.7次迭代。在匿名化条件下，所有模型仍保持100%的成功率，迭代次数适度增加（为原来的1.36–1.67倍），这为其稳健的符号推理提供了证据。
items.author_line: Aboubaker Seddiq Benterki, Jüri Vain, Gert Kanter, Leelo Aino Jürgenstein

items.title: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliability in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a 1/μ^2 oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale μ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results motivate the ZO-BOLT algorithm, which builds on BOLT's matched-data advantage for reliable ZO optimization of an RLVR-aligned objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three models and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch.
items.summary_zh: 论文建立零阶优化梯度估计的方差理论，说明匹配数据可消除噪声放大，并提出 ZO-BOLT；显式收敛保证和端到端实验支持了理论预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时给出可分析的噪声机制、带常数的收敛保证和数学推理基准实验，能检验优化方法是否真的改善了可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: 零阶（ZO）优化已成为一种有前景的、节省内存的大语言模型（LLM）后训练方法，但其在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中的可靠性仍缺乏研究。针对在策略 RL 与固定数据优化的不同数据机制，我们建立了一个通用的方差理论框架，用于研究限制 ZO 梯度估计可靠性的因素。我们的分析表明，估计可靠性在结构上取决于两次有限差分评估是否使用匹配的数据。在数据不匹配机制下，在策略强化学习（RL）会产生 1/��^2 的预言机噪声放大；当扰动尺度 �� 减小时，这会形成不可消除的噪声下限。相反，在数据匹配机制下，Boltzmann Targeted SFT（BOLT）通过噪声抵消消除了这种放大。我们进一步推导了带有显式常数的收敛保证，清楚地区分这两种机制。这些结果促成了 ZO-BOLT 算法：它利用 BOLT 在数据匹配方面的优势，对与 RLVR 对齐的目标进行可靠的 ZO 优化。受控的扰动尺度扫描，以及匹配数据与不匹配数据的端到端比较，验证了数据匹配的预测效应。在三个模型和两个数学推理基准上的实验还表明，ZO-BOLT 在保持接近推理阶段的内存占用的同时，持续优于预训练基线。代码公开于 https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch。
items.author_line: Lianmin Chen, Junbin Qiu, Chenxing Wei, Yao Shu, Kun He

items.title: Reap: Uncovering Monte Carlo proof search with a lightweight model
items.abstract_or_text: We present Reap, an open framework for learning and analyzing formal proof search in Lean4. Reap implements policy-value-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search directly in Lean, sharing proof-state transitions, AND-OR search, and replay verification between inference and training rollouts. Structured action logs expose how neural predictions and tactic execution interact during search. Using this framework, we train Reaper-1, a 1.7B-parameter policy-value model, through continued pre-training, supervised tactic learning, and iterative search-based reinforcement learning. Using a separate premise selector, the final system solves 79.9% of miniF2F-test at pass@32, establishing state-of-the-art performance among open provers of comparable size while remaining competitive with substantially larger models. Beyond improved solve rates, our results suggest that RL strengthens the prover's ability to organize proofs around useful intermediate results, favoring substantial advances over repeated local adjustments. This more directed proof construction is accompanied by increasingly elaborate tactic programs: fewer explicit search decisions are needed, while more work is performed within each decision. The resulting trade-off between search effort and tactic execution cost provides insight into how learning changes the prover's problem-solving strategy.
items.summary_zh: Reap 在 Lean4 中实现策略—价值引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，并共享证明状态转移、AND-OR 搜索与回放验证；1.7B 参数的 Reaper-1 在 miniF2F-test 上达到 pass@32 79.9%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 证明状态由 Lean 检查，搜索过程有结构化日志，评测指标明确，适合检验轻量模型在形式化证明搜索中的能力与代价。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Reap，一个用于在 Lean4 中学习和分析形式化证明搜索的开放框架。Reap 直接在 Lean 中实现策略—价值引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，并在推理和训练 rollout 之间共享证明状态转移、AND-OR 搜索和回放验证。结构化动作日志展示了神经预测与 tactic 执行如何交互。利用这一框架，我们通过持续预训练、tactic 监督学习和基于搜索的迭代强化学习，训练了一个拥有17亿参数的策略—价值模型 Reaper-1。结合独立的前提选择器后，最终系统在 miniF2F-test 上达到 pass@32 为79.9%的求解率，在规模相当的开放证明器中达到 state-of-the-art，同时仍能与规模大得多的模型竞争。除了提高求解率之外，我们的结果表明，强化学习增强了证明器围绕有用中间结果组织证明的能力，更倾向于取得实质性进展，而不是反复进行局部调整。这种更有方向性的证明构造还伴随着越来越复杂的 tactic 程序：所需的显式搜索决策更少，但每次决策内部完成的工作更多。由此形成的搜索努力与 tactic 执行成本之间的权衡，为理解学习如何改变证明器的问题求解策略提供了线索。
items.author_line: Yutong Wang, Xuanzhi Ren, Tianyi Xu, Ruitong Liu, Jingda Xu, Peihao Wu, Bryan Dai, Bin Dong

items.title: RLiD: Reinforcement Learning in the Decision Plane for Language Agents and LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) has improved the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) across a wide range of tasks. However, token-level RL assigns an action's advantage to the entire generated response, including tokens specifying the parsed action, reasoning chains, and malformed content. Although the environment executes only the parsed action, variation in how the action is expressed in natural language can introduce additional variance into policy-gradient estimates. We propose RLiD (Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane), a framework that directly optimizes the probabilities of executable action options. RLiD compiles observations, an optional compact memory, and a labeled action menu into the model input, and uses a large decision model (LDM) to select an action in a single forward pass. By eliminating autoregressive token generation and bypassing action parsing, RLiD avoids invalid action outputs and improves RL rollout efficiency. Our analysis shows that, within a fixed text policy, marginalizing over alternative realizations of the same action removes a zero-mean gradient component without changing the expected update. We further distill trained LDM policies into generative LLMs through supervision on their action trajectories. Experiments on ARC, Countdown, and Sokoban demonstrate improved performance or lower computational cost across several settings. On ALFWorld, the complete training and distillation pipeline reaches 99.3% success in 12.7 H100 GPU-hours, compared with 86.6% in 17.3 GPU-hours for token-level RL of the same LLM. With compiled memory, our strongest Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM and distilled generative LLM achieve 100% success on all 134 unseen and 140 seen ALFWorld evaluation games.
items.summary_zh: RLiD 将强化学习从生成整段文本改为直接优化可执行动作选项，并给出梯度方差分析；在 ALFWorld 上以更少 GPU 时间达到99.3%成功率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把动作解析误差与策略梯度方差分开处理，既有理论解释，也有跨任务成功率和计算成本评测。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已经在广泛任务上提升了大型语言模型（LLM）的能力。然而，token 级 RL 会把一个动作的优势分配给整个生成响应，其中包括指定解析动作的 token、推理链和格式错误的内容。尽管环境只执行解析后的动作，但动作以自然语言表达的方式不同，会给策略梯度估计引入额外方差。我们提出 RLiD（Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane），一个直接优化可执行动作选项概率的框架。RLiD 将观测、可选的紧凑记忆和带标签的动作菜单编译到模型输入中，并使用大型决策模型（LDM）通过一次前向传播选择动作。通过消除自回归 token 生成并绕过动作解析，RLiD 避免了无效动作输出并提高了 RL rollout 效率。我们的分析表明，在固定的文本策略内，对同一动作的不同表达进行边缘化，可以去除一个均值为零的梯度分量，同时不改变期望更新。我们还通过对动作轨迹进行监督，把训练好的 LDM 策略蒸馏到生成式 LLM 中。在 ARC、Countdown 和 Sokoban 上的实验显示，RLiD 在多种设置下提高了性能或降低了计算成本。在 ALFWorld 上，完整的训练与蒸馏流程以12.7个 H100 GPU 小时达到99.3%的成功率，而同一 LLM 的 token 级 RL 以17.3个 GPU 小时达到86.6%。在使用编译记忆时，最强的 Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM 和蒸馏后的生成式 LLM 在全部134个未见过的评测游戏和140个已见过的评测游戏上都达到100%成功率。
items.author_line: Ziyi Chen, Yan Zhang, Jianhui Wei, Jianing Yin, Daoan Zhang

items.title: AlgoPilot: Cross-Paradigm Reasoning in Language Models via Strategy Selection and Guidance
items.abstract_or_text: Real-world problems span diverse domains, including program synthesis, symbolic reasoning, planning, and optimization, and often require fundamentally different solution paradigms. A central challenge for LLM-based reasoning is twofold: identifying an appropriate problem-solving approach and formulating it correctly. In this paper, we propose AlgoPilot, a cross-paradigm reasoning framework that enables adaptive selection of the solving approaches and structured problem formulation prior to execution. The AlgoPilot framework contains three components: 1) a SteerLM, trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), that adaptively selects the solving strategy (paradigm and modes) based on input problems, 2) the corresponding expert GuideLM, trained via SFT, that generates structured formulation guidance tailored to the selected strategy, and 3) an ExecutionLM that generates solutions conditioned on both the selected strategy and its formulation. Unlike prompting-based methods that rely on fixed reasoning templates, our approach learns to adaptively choose and structure problem-solving strategies based on the input. We build AlgoPilot on Qwen3-8B and evaluate across 5 problem categories and 13 benchmarks with 66 unique domains, comparing against both the latest similarly scaled small models and large LLMs. AlgoPilot significantly improves average accuracy for the same model from 38.4% to 72.9%, outperforming the best large LLM prompting baseline GLM-5 by 11.7%. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component. Notably, we show that the learned steering and formulation modules can transfer across execution models, suggesting their potential to improve other LLMs. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/algopilot.
items.summary_zh: AlgoPilot 先选择问题求解范式，再生成结构化建模指导并执行；在5类问题、13个基准和66个领域上评估，同一模型平均准确率从38.4%提升到72.9%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务空间覆盖程序合成、符号推理、规划和优化，且有模块消融与跨执行模型迁移评测，能检验策略选择是否真正带来泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 现实问题涵盖程序合成、符号推理、规划和优化等多种领域，通常需要根本不同的求解范式。基于 LLM 的推理面临的一个核心挑战有两个方面：识别合适的问题求解方法，并正确地进行问题表述。在本文中，我们提出 AlgoPilot，一种跨范式推理框架，使模型能够自适应地选择求解方法，并在执行前进行结构化的问题表述。AlgoPilot 包含三个组件：1）SteerLM，通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）训练，根据输入问题自适应地选择求解策略（范式和模式）；2）相应的专家 GuideLM，通过 SFT 训练，生成针对所选策略的结构化表述指导；3）ExecutionLM，根据所选策略及其表述生成解答。不同于依赖固定推理模板的提示方法，该方法学习根据输入自适应地选择并组织求解策略。我们基于 Qwen3-8B 构建 AlgoPilot，并在5类问题、13个基准和66个不同领域上进行评估，同时与最新的同规模小模型和大型 LLM 比较。AlgoPilot 将同一模型的平均准确率从38.4%显著提高到72.9%，并超过最佳大型 LLM 提示基线 GLM-5 11.7%。消融实验验证了各组件的作用。值得注意的是，我们还表明，学习到的引导和表述模块可以迁移到不同的执行模型上，说明它们有潜力改进其他 LLM。项目主页：https://sites.google.com/view/algopilot。
items.author_line: Yilun Hao, Ruixiao Yang, Hudson Hilal, Yongchao Chen, Kaizhi Qian, Yada Zhu, Yang Zhang, Chuchu Fan

items.title: Solver-Like Behavior in Large Language Models as Formalizers
items.abstract_or_text: In the LLM-as-formalizer paradigm, a large language model translates a problem into a formal program and leaves the search to a solver, gaining the solver's guarantees. Formalizers are now often reasoning models that write a long reasoning trace before the program, yet they are judged only by the program's output. We find that the trace routinely does the solver's job, assigning, testing and ruling out values until it often reaches the full answer; we call this solver-like behavior (SLB). We define an ontology of SLB over the trace, the program and its output, and use LLM judges, checked against human labels, to label 2,000 generations from three reasoning models on four constraint satisfaction datasets, each formalized in a declarative and an imperative formal language. SLB appears in 85% of traces and takes 24% of reasoning tokens, yet the program usually recomputes the answer, so the effort is redundant. The 9% of programs that inherit the trace's answer also inherit its errors, and pass output-based evaluation whenever that answer is correct. The amount of SLB is not associated with accuracy, and SLB is more common in imperative Python than in declarative Z3 or PDDL. Cautionary prompts reduce it by only a quarter, but hiding the problem's values behind placeholders, which the program receives only at run time, removes 97% of it without loss of accuracy. Formalizers should therefore be evaluated by how their programs are reached, not only by what they output.
items.summary_zh: 研究分析 LLM 形式化器在生成程序前的推理轨迹是否已替求解器完成搜索；在2000条生成结果上发现 solver-like behavior 很常见，但与准确率并不相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提醒形式化器评测不能只看最终程序输出，还应检查推理轨迹是否冗余、是否把答案错误带入程序。
items.abstract_zh: 在“LLM 作为形式化器”的范式中，大语言模型将问题翻译为形式程序，并把搜索交给求解器，从而获得求解器的保证。如今的形式化器通常是推理模型，会在程序之前写出很长的推理轨迹，但评测只看程序的输出。我们发现，这些轨迹经常替求解器完成工作：分配、测试并排除取值，直到常常得到完整答案；我们将这种现象称为 solver-like behavior（SLB）。我们定义了关于轨迹、程序及其输出的 SLB 本体，并使用经过人工标签校验的 LLM 评审，对三个推理模型在四个约束满足数据集上的2000条生成结果进行标注；每个数据集都用声明式和命令式形式语言进行形式化。SLB 出现在85%的轨迹中，占推理 token 的24%，但程序通常会重新计算答案，因此这些工作往往是冗余的。9%的程序继承了轨迹中的答案，也继承了其中的错误；只要该答案正确，它们就能通过基于输出的评测。SLB 的数量与准确率没有关联，而且在命令式 Python 中比在声明式 Z3 或 PDDL 中更常见。谨慎提示只能将其减少四分之一；但把问题的取值隐藏在占位符后、让程序只在运行时接收这些取值，可以在不损失准确率的情况下消除97%的 SLB。因此，形式化器应根据程序是如何得到的来评测，而不应只看它输出了什么。
items.author_line: Rikhil Amonkar, Stuti Mohan, Kevin Nguyen, Ceyhun Efe Kayan, Ronan Le Bras, Li Zhang

items.title: From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
items.abstract_or_text: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation has substantially improved the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, including code generation, data analysis, and exam-style question answering. Despite these advances, purely neural LLMs continue to struggle with elementary logical reasoning problems and lack the determinism, soundness, and reliability characteristic of symbolic reasoning systems. Conversely, classical symbolic methods such as SAT solving and exact cover guarantee correctness and completeness, but require problems to be expressed in highly specialized formal encodings, limiting their applicability to natural language inputs. In this work, we present a synergistic neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by combining neural semantic parsing with deterministic exact cover reasoning. Given a Zebra-style logic puzzle in natural language, an LLM translates entities and constraints into structured tool calls that construct an exact cover instance. A symbolic solver then computes the solution and provides feedback to iteratively refine invalid, under- or overconstrained encodings, exploiting the uniqueness property of Zebra puzzles. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation across multiple parameter scales, post-training paradigms, and LLM families. The results demonstrate that our hybrid approach consistently outperforms strong plain neural baselines, including CoT prompting, as well as recent neuro-symbolic methods.
items.summary_zh: 该神经符号框架把自然语言 Zebra 谜题解析为精确覆盖实例，再由确定性求解器计算并反馈修正编码；综合评测显示其优于纯神经 CoT 和近期神经符号基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把自然语言理解与具有完备性、正确性保证的符号求解分开，任务定义和可检验结果都很明确。
items.abstract_zh: 思维链（CoT）生成显著提升了大型语言模型（LLM）在复杂推理任务上的表现，包括代码生成、数据分析和考试式问答。尽管取得了这些进展，纯神经 LLM 仍然难以处理基础逻辑推理问题，也缺乏符号推理系统所具有的确定性、可靠性和可验证性。相反，SAT 求解和精确覆盖等经典符号方法能够保证正确性和完备性，但要求问题采用高度专门化的形式编码，限制了它们处理自然语言输入的适用性。在本文中，我们提出一个协同的神经符号框架，通过结合神经语义解析与确定性的精确覆盖推理来弥合这一差距。给定一个自然语言 Zebra 风格逻辑谜题，LLM 将实体和约束翻译成结构化工具调用，以构造一个精确覆盖实例。随后，符号求解器计算解，并利用反馈迭代修正无效、约束不足或约束过度的编码，同时利用 Zebra 谜题的唯一性。我们在多个参数规模、后训练范式和 LLM 家族上进行了全面的实证评估。结果表明，我们的混合方法持续优于强大的纯神经基线（包括 CoT 提示）以及近期的神经符号方法。
items.author_line: Paulius Skaisgiris, Thomas Pammer, Veronika Semmelrock, Mykyta Ielanskyi, Maximilian Heisinger, Erich Kobler

items.title: Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
items.abstract_or_text: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.
items.summary_zh: 研究复现8个多模态基准的官方评分器，并用盲法人类加 LLM 仲裁校验答案；同一输出仅因评分规则不同就可能产生最多22个百分点的准确率差异。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 说明基准评分器本身会混淆模型能力与解析规则，提出报告不合规率并使用至少两种评分规则。
items.abstract_zh: 每个多模态 LLM 选择题基准最终都有一个评分规则，把模型的回答（通常是自由文本，而不是干净的选项字母）转换为对错判定，并隐藏在代码中。与数据集不同，这条规则通常没有得到论证，也没有经过审查，但它决定了发布的分数。我们在五个可以放入单块16 GB GPU 的开放视觉语言模型（VLM）上复现了八个同行评审基准的官方评分器，并引入盲法的人类加 LLM 评审仲裁，以恢复模型实际回答的内容（Cohen's kappa=0.956）。在完全相同的输出上，仅评分规则就能让准确率相差最多22个百分点；但当模型输出干净的选项字母时，差异恰好为0，因此这一问题会在强模型排行榜上隐藏起来。真正造成影响的是后备规则，而不是冗长回答：我们测得不合规率最高的基准，其评分器因为选择弃权而不是猜测，产生的偏差恰好为0；一个不合规率为0.000的推理模型，也会仅因解析器保留其推理轨迹中的哪一个正则表达式匹配而产生9.5个百分点的波动。没有一种标准规则是可靠的：把非答案吸附到最近的选项会给模型没有作出的答案记分，却埋没用文字表达的正确答案；弃权会丢弃用文字陈述的答案；似然评分则会跟随答案 token 的先验，因此单一分数把能力与运气混在一起，却无法测量其中任何一个。我们发布了全部代码、标签和协议，并主张基准应报告不合规率，且至少使用两种评分规则，而不是依赖一种未经审查的分数。
items.author_line: Ahmad Jarjis Hasan, Jonathan Lwowski

items.title: What makes a theorem interesting? Operationalizing interestingness for open-ended exploration
items.abstract_or_text: An agent that explores, whether it generates conjectures or research ideas, must decide which of them are worth keeping. This judgment of interestingness is usually delegated to a hand-picked proxy or to a language model, neither of which is known to correspond to what humans actually value. I study it for mathematical theorems, by observing which results mathematicians single out in formal libraries and in papers. I model each way of singling out results as an evaluator that weights features of a result's statement, its proof and dependencies, and split its weights into a shared and a subjective part. In formalized mathematics, ex-ante features predict these selections as well as a large language-model judge, and the two complement each other. Interestingness is also largely shared. One set of weights, carried mostly by structural features such as the length of the statement and of the proof and the subfields the proof draws on, accounts for most of the signal and transfers in part across formal libraries. What remains subjective depends on practices and individual authors more than on subfields. The judge's advantage lies in its knowledge of the canon, and neither the judge nor the features rely on memory of the papers. The approach, which infers what a community finds interesting from what it singles out, can be applied to other sciences.
items.summary_zh: 论文把“定理是否有趣”建模为从形式化数学库与论文中学习的评估器，分析陈述、证明和依赖关系特征；事前特征在预测选择方面可达到与 LLM 评审相当的效果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将开放式数学探索中的选题价值转化为可测量问题，并检验结构特征、主观差异和跨形式库迁移。
items.abstract_zh: 一个进行探索的智能体，无论是生成猜想还是研究想法，都必须决定哪些结果值得保留。这种“有趣性”判断通常交给手工挑选的代理指标或语言模型，但没人知道它们是否对应人类真正重视的内容。我通过观察数学家在形式化数学库和论文中挑出的结果，研究数学定理的这一问题。我把每一种挑选结果的方式建模为一个评估器，它对结果陈述、证明和依赖关系的特征进行加权，并将权重拆分为共享部分和主观部分。在形式化数学中，事前特征对这些选择的预测能力与大型语言模型评审相当，而且二者能够互补。“有趣性”在很大程度上是共享的。一组主要由结构特征驱动的权重（例如陈述和证明的长度，以及证明所涉及的子领域）解释了大部分信号，并且在不同形式化数学库之间有一定程度的迁移。剩余的主观部分更多取决于学术实践和个体作者，而不是子领域。评审器的优势来自其对经典文献的知识；但评审器和特征都不依赖对论文内容的记忆。该方法从一个共同体挑选哪些结果这一行为中推断其认为什么有趣，也可以应用到其他科学领域。
items.author_line: Silvère Gangloff

items.title: ProofPaths: An AI Agent Framework for Assessing Student Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Students can use large language models to complete assignments, but a correct solution does not establish whether they understand the reasoning behind it. Individualized interviews can probe that understanding but require recurring staff effort. We introduce ProofPaths, an AI agentic framework that combines rubric-based grading with individualized and interactive interviews. Multiple grading agents assess a submission against instructor guidance, exchange critiques, and revise their judgments. Their scores determine which review supplies the grade and feedback. An interview agent asks students to justify steps in their submission and uses their answers to guide follow-up questions. Each question is linked to a retrieved submission excerpt, so instructors can compare the student's explanation with the cited passage. The system tracks assessment progress and stores grading reviews and interview transcripts for each submission. Several deterministic tests of the assessment controllers check source handling, score aggregation, and limits on correction attempts. Instructors can inspect all reviews and transcripts and override grades within the assignment workflow.
items.summary_zh: ProofPaths 将基于量规的评分与个性化互动访谈结合，用多个评分代理审阅提交，并通过确定性测试检查评估控制器的源处理、分数聚合和纠错限制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把“答案正确”与“学生是否理解推理”区分开，并保留可检查的评审记录和控制器测试。
items.abstract_zh: 学生可以使用大型语言模型完成作业，但正确的解答并不能证明他们理解背后的推理。个性化访谈可以探查这种理解，但需要教职员工反复投入时间。我们提出 ProofPaths，一个将基于量规的评分与个性化互动访谈结合起来的 AI 智能体框架。多个评分智能体根据教师指导评估提交内容，互相交换批评意见并修订判断。它们的分数决定采用哪份评审作为成绩和反馈。访谈智能体要求学生为提交中的步骤辩护，并利用学生的回答引导后续提问。每个问题都链接到检索出的提交片段，使教师能够将学生的解释与被引用的原文进行比较。系统跟踪评估进度，并为每份提交保存评分评审和访谈记录。多个确定性测试检查评估控制器的源处理、分数聚合和纠错次数上限。教师可以在作业流程中检查所有评审和记录，并覆盖最终成绩。
items.author_line: Mohsen Hariri, Vipin Chaudhary

items.title: Not All Reasoning Generalizes: A Case Study on Learning Generalizable Reasoning Strategies in RLVR
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can enable generalizable improvement for large language model (LLM) reasoning. This paper studies how to incentivize such generalization via reasoning strategies. We study this question with a controllable equation-solving framework: finding multiple inputs x for equations f(x)=y, where f is a non-bijective string function. This setting makes reasoning strategies observable while supporting a clear definition of easy-to-hard out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts, e.g., more solutions, longer y, etc. We uncover a subtle RLVR failure: it teaches the model to solve in-distribution tasks with high accuracy and structured step-by-step derivation, yet under OOD shifts, the same model abandons derivation and collapses to ineffective brute-force enumeration, causing sharp accuracy drops. This observation reveals the deeper challenges of RLVR generalization as it is neither incapable base model nor reward hacking, since the model succeeds in-distribution with the correct reasoning strategy. The key to mitigating this failure is an indirect intervention that surprisingly helps: co-training with bijective inversion tasks. Although these bijective tasks are actually not uniformly harder and even further from the non-bijective OOD evaluation, they make derivation more certain and substantially restore the correct strategy and accuracy under OOD shifts. This effect further motivates our theoretical analysis: outcome-only RLVR can shape reasoning processes through implicitly crediting the effective reasoning strategies more, even without process supervision. To conclude, our analysis framework and findings systematically reveal the crucial role and incentivization of reasoning strategies in RLVR generalization under OOD shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/ziqipang/rl_meta_thinking.
items.summary_zh: 在可控方程求解框架中，论文发现 RLVR 可能只在分布内教会模型结构化推导，遇到分布外变化时退化为低效穷举；与双射逆问题共同训练可恢复策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务支持清晰的难度迁移和可观察推理策略，揭示结果奖励并不保证推理过程在分布外保持泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可以让大型语言模型（LLM）的推理获得可泛化的改进。本文研究如何通过推理策略来激励这种泛化。我们使用一个可控的方程求解框架：为方程 f(x)=y 找到多个输入 x，其中 f 是非双射字符串函数。该设置使推理策略可被观察，同时支持对易到难的分布外（OOD）迁移进行清晰定义，例如增加解的数量、延长 y 等。我们发现了 RLVR 的一个微妙失败模式：它教会模型以高准确率和结构化的逐步推导解决分布内任务，但在 OOD 迁移下，同一个模型会放弃推导，退化为无效的暴力枚举，导致准确率骤降。这一现象揭示了 RLVR 泛化的更深层挑战：问题既不是基础模型没有能力，也不是奖励投机，因为模型在分布内能够以正确的推理策略成功。缓解这一失败的关键是一个间接干预：与双射逆问题共同训练，出人意料地有帮助。尽管这些双射任务并非始终更难，且与非双射 OOD 评测的距离更远，但它们使推导更加确定，并大幅恢复了 OOD 条件下的正确策略和准确率。这一结果进一步促成了我们的理论分析：即使没有过程监督，仅依赖结果的 RLVR 也能通过隐式地给予有效推理策略更多信用来塑造推理过程。总之，我们的分析框架和发现系统地揭示了 RLVR 泛化中推理策略的关键作用及其激励方式。代码公开于 https://github.com/ziqipang/rl_meta_thinking。
items.author_line: Ziqi Pang, Yu-Xiong Wang

items.title: As Expected? Efficient LLM Planning via Expectation-Observation Consistency Verification
items.abstract_or_text: LLM planning often relies on reactive executors (e.g., ReAct) that generate a single action at each step to remain grounded in the latest observations, incurring substantial inference cost. Batched executors reduce this cost by predicting multiple actions in a single model invocation, yet they are prone to compounding errors, as intermediate observations are ignored. We propose an expectation-observation consistency verification (EOCV) mechanism for batched executors, preserving grounding while improving efficiency. The mechanism generates expectations of action outcomes and compares them with the resulting observations. Consistency permits continued execution, whereas mismatches trigger early termination and replanning from the current observation. Experiments on text-based and multimodal benchmarks across multiple backbones show broadly comparable average task performance between EOCV and reactive executors, with a 29-35% reduction in average weighted token usage. Moreover, the mechanism is model-agnostic and remains effective when integrated into state-of-the-art planners.
items.summary_zh: EOCV 为批量规划器生成动作结果预期，并将其与实际观测比较；不一致时提前终止并重新规划，在保持近似任务表现的同时减少29–35%的加权 token 使用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 验证条件、触发重规划的机制和效率指标都明确，能检验批量执行是否在降低成本时保持环境一致性。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 规划通常依赖反应式执行器（例如 ReAct），每一步只生成一个动作以保持与最新观测的结合，但这会带来较高的推理成本。批量执行器可以在一次模型调用中预测多个动作，从而降低成本，但由于忽略中间观测，容易产生累积错误。我们提出期望—观测一致性验证（EOCV）机制，为批量执行器保留环境对齐能力并提高效率。该机制生成动作结果的预期，并将其与实际观测进行比较。一致时允许继续执行；不一致时提前终止，并基于当前观测重新规划。在多个骨干模型上的文本和多模态基准实验表明，EOCV 与反应式执行器的平均任务表现大体相当，同时将平均加权 token 使用量减少29–35%。此外，该机制与模型无关，集成到 state-of-the-art 规划器中仍然有效。
items.author_line: Qingfu Zhu, Huanyang Zheng, Ting Liu, Wanxiang Che

items.title: Certifying Graph Neural Networks Against Label and Structure Poisoning
items.abstract_or_text: Robust machine learning for graph-structured data has made significant progress against test-time attacks, yet certified robustness to poisoning - where adversaries manipulate the training data - remains largely underexplored. For image data, state-of-the-art poisoning certificates rely on partitioning-and-aggregation schemes. However, we show that these methods fail when applied in the graph domain due to the inherent label and structure sparsity found in common graph datasets, making effective graph-partitioning difficult. To address this challenge, we propose a novel semi-supervised learning framework called deep Self-Training Graph Partition Aggregation (ST-GPA), which enriches each graph partition with informative pseudo-labels and synthetic edges, enabling effective certification against node-label and graph-structure poisoning under sparse conditions. Our method is architecture-agnostic, scales to large numbers of partitions, and consistently and significantly improves robustness guarantees against both label and structure poisoning across multiple benchmarks, while maintaining strong clean accuracy. Overall, our results establish a promising direction for certifiably robust learning on graph-structured data against poisoning under sparse conditions.
items.summary_zh: ST-GPA 用伪标签和合成边增强图分区，在稀疏图数据上为标签投毒和结构投毒提供认证鲁棒性；方法跨架构并在多个基准上提升鲁棒性保证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究的是可认证的训练时鲁棒性，而非只在测试时防御攻击；认证保证与干净准确率同时报告，结果可检验。
items.abstract_zh: 面向图结构数据的鲁棒机器学习在应对测试时攻击方面已取得显著进展，但对投毒的认证鲁棒性（即攻击者操纵训练数据）仍研究不足。对于图像数据，最先进的投毒认证依赖划分与聚合方案。然而，我们表明，由于常见图数据集固有的标签和结构稀疏性，这些方法应用于图领域时会失效，使有效的图划分变得困难。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种称为深度自训练图划分聚合（deep Self-Training Graph Partition Aggregation，ST-GPA）的半监督学习框架。它用信息丰富的伪标签和合成边增强每个图分区，从而在稀疏条件下实现针对节点标签投毒和图结构投毒的有效认证。该方法与架构无关，可以扩展到大量分区，并在多个基准上持续且显著地提升对标签投毒和结构投毒的鲁棒性保证，同时保持较强的干净准确率。总体而言，我们的结果为在稀疏条件下实现针对图结构数据投毒的可认证鲁棒学习提供了一个有前景的方向。
items.author_line: Lukas Gosch, Xichuan Chen, Yan Scholten, Stephan Günnemann

items.title: Action Verification through Conjecture and Refutation for Language Model Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Language model agents increasingly act on users' behalf by manipulating external environments through tools, often from high-level instructions that leave critical task- and environment-specific context unstated. To prevent resulting misaligned actions, recent work verifies proposed actions before execution, largely by establishing whether the conditions supporting them hold. We argue that this confirmation-oriented view leaves a fundamental blind spot: a wrong action often passes every check that asks whether it is right. This motivates a different question for verification: rather than asking what evidence supports an action, can the agent find evidence that refutes it? We pursue this direction with BlackSwan, a refutation-oriented, expect-suspect-test procedure that predicts the intended effect of each state-mutating action, formulates specific and empirically testable hypotheses for how it could be wrong, and tests them using existing observations or additional non-mutating actions, executing the action only if none survives testing. On challenging AppWorld tasks, BlackSwan improves success rate over the strongest baseline by 14.9 and 25.2%p with and without the backbone model's thinking mode, respectively. Even without thinking or in-context demonstrations, it outperforms stronger baselines equipped with them. The gains also transfer beyond AppWorld, with BlackSwan improving WebShop performance by 12.7%p. More broadly, our results suggest that language model agents have an underused capacity to recognize and self-correct misaligned actions, which can be systematically elicited through active conjecture and refutation before execution.
items.summary_zh: BlackSwan 在执行状态变更动作前，主动预测预期效果、提出可证伪的错误假设并进行反驳测试；在 AppWorld 和 WebShop 上显著提升任务成功率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把动作验证从“寻找支持证据”扩展到“主动寻找反证”，任务流程和跨环境评测清晰。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体越来越多地代表用户通过工具操作外部环境，而高层指令常常没有说明关键的任务和环境上下文。为防止由此产生的不对齐动作，近期工作主要在执行前验证提议的动作，重点确认支持这些动作的条件是否成立。我们认为，这种以确认​​为中心的观点存在一个根本盲点：错误动作可能通过所有“它是正确的”检查。因此，验证时不应只问什么证据支持一个动作，还应问智能体能否找到反驳它的证据。我们沿着这一方向提出 BlackSwan，一种面向反驳的“预期—怀疑—测试”流程：它预测每个会改变状态的动作的预期效果，针对动作可能出错的方式提出具体且可实证检验的假设，并利用已有观测或额外的非变更动作进行测试；只有在没有任何假设通过测试后才执行该动作。在具有挑战性的 AppWorld 任务上，无论骨干模型是否启用思考模式，BlackSwan 相对最强基线分别将成功率提高14.9和25.2个百分点。即使不使用思考或上下文示例，它也优于配备这些能力的更强基线。该收益还能迁移到 AppWorld 之外：在 WebShop 上，BlackSwan 将表现提高12.7个百分点。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，语言模型智能体具备尚未充分利用的识别和自我纠正不对齐动作的能力，而在执行前主动进行猜想与反驳可以系统地激发这种能力。
items.author_line: Minhyeon Oh, Chiyeong Heo, Geonwoo Noh, Hoyoung Kim, Jangwon Son, Jungseul Ok

items.title: Creating Hybrid Interactive Narrative Systems with LLM: From Formal Description to Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Interactive narratives let users shape a story while an Experience Manager (EM) keeps it coherent, balancing player freedom against authorial control. Large Language Models now enable a new generation of hybrid EMs, which combine run-time generation from free-text input with symbolic narrative control. However, their heterogeneity makes them hard to compare: A manager's behaviour is generally tied to the unique and specific scenario in which it operates, and much of its decision-making takes place outside of any explicit and verifiable structure. We address this with an LLM-based narrative platform whose managers are interchangeable modules operating over a shared symbolic world model of facts, operations, and goals. Because every applied operation carries explicit preconditions and effects, each session can be analysed as a plan through a common state-transition representation and evaluated, independently of how the manager works internally, with shared indicators of four properties: player agency, EM controllability, author intent, and robustness. We implement three contrasting managers, based respectively on open generation, Monte Carlo repair, and autonomous characters, and compare them through functional analysis on an interactive Little Red Riding Hood scenario. The results show that no manager dominates on every property, giving authors and EM designers a concrete basis to select a manager according to their priorities.
items.summary_zh: 该平台用共享的符号世界模型表示事实、操作和目标，使不同 LLM 叙事管理器可互换，并以玩家能动性、可控性、作者意图和鲁棒性进行统一评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将生成式管理器置于带显式前置条件和效果的状态转移系统中，提供了可比较、可验证的叙事规划评测。
items.abstract_zh: 互动叙事让用户塑造故事，同时由体验管理器（Experience Manager，EM）维持连贯性，在玩家自由与作者控制之间进行平衡。大型语言模型如今支持新一代混合式 EM：它们将自由文本输入的运行时生成与符号叙事控制结合起来。然而，这类管理器异质性很高，难以相互比较：管理器的行为通常与其运行的独特而具体的场景绑定，大部分决策发生在任何显式且可验证的结构之外。为此，我们提出一个基于 LLM 的叙事平台，其中管理器是可互换模块，运行在一个共享的符号世界模型上，该模型包含事实、操作和目标。由于每个应用的操作都带有显式前置条件和效果，每次会话都可以通过共同的状态转移表示作为一个计划进行分析，并且不依赖管理器的内部工作方式，用四项共同指标进行评估：玩家能动性、EM 可控性、作者意图和鲁棒性。我们实现了三个有明显差异的管理器，分别基于开放生成、蒙特卡洛修复和自主角色，并在互动版《小红帽》场景中通过功能分析进行比较。结果表明，没有任何一个管理器在所有性质上都占优，这为作者和 EM 设计者按自身优先级选择管理器提供了具体依据。
items.author_line: Jules Clerc, Domitile Lourdeaux, Mohamed Sallak, Marc Ravaine

items.title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid. We present LeanGuard, a runtime that checks every proposed tool call against a policy written in Lean4 before the call reaches the environment. Policies combine state predicates with scoped past-time temporal operators over the execution history, evaluation is fail-closed, and the decision procedure is proved equivalent to a LeanLTL semantics. A denied call can be corrected in two ways. With feedback, the agent receives the violated rule and a hint; with proof-guided repair, Lean metaprogramming searches for a nearby call that preserves the user's intent and proves that the policy admits it, without the model. On Tau-Bench with five Qwen models (0.8B-27B), unguarded agents execute at least 33 calls that the Lean policy forbids, while LeanGuard executes none; with feedback, task success does not change significantly. On DTap, LeanGuard reduces direct prompt-injection success from 57.9% to 5.9%, and in telecom, where benign tasks need no writes, benign success is unchanged. Feedback reduces repeated blocked calls and raises task success for four of five models over a bare denial. On replayed denials, repair proves an admissible edit for 88 of 252 denials caused by argument values, in a median of 2,ms.
items.summary_zh: LeanGuard 在工具调用到达环境前，用 Lean4 编写的策略检查每次调用；其决策过程已证明与 LeanLTL 语义等价，并在 Tau-Bench、DTap 等任务上阻止违规调用和降低提示注入成功率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把策略执行、失败关闭和证明引导修复放入形式化验证框架，安全效果与任务成功率均有可检验评测。
items.abstract_zh: 使用工具的语言模型智能体经常执行其领域策略所禁止的动作。我们提出 LeanGuard，一个运行时系统：在工具调用到达环境之前，它会根据用 Lean4 编写的策略检查每次提议的工具调用。策略将状态谓词与执行历史上的有作用域的过去时态算子结合起来；评估采用失败关闭方式，且其决策过程已证明与 LeanLTL 语义等价。被拒绝的调用可以通过两种方式修正。使用反馈时，智能体会收到被违反的规则和提示；使用证明引导修复时，Lean 元编程会搜索一个既保持用户意图、又能证明被策略允许的邻近调用，整个过程不依赖模型。在 Tau-Bench 上，使用五个 Qwen 模型（0.8B–27B）的未防护智能体至少执行了33次 Lean 策略禁止的调用，而 LeanGuard 一次也没有执行；加入反馈后，任务成功率没有显著变化。在 DTap 上，LeanGuard 将直接提示注入成功率从57.9%降至5.9%；在电信场景中，良性任务无需写操作，因此良性成功率保持不变。反馈减少了重复的被阻止调用，并使五个模型中的四个相对于简单拒绝提高了任务成功率。在重放的拒绝调用中，修复机制对由参数值导致的252次拒绝中的88次证明了可接受的编辑，中位数为2,ms。

items.abstract_or_text: We asked GPT-6 Astra to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B weights to improve math. It directly changed only 0.016% of weights, fixing 0.8B reasoning loops and improving math up to 6x and even instruction following 3x, without gradients or training. items.abstract_zh: 我们让 GPT-6 Astra 编辑 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的权重以改进数学能力。它只直接改动了 0.016% 的权重，修复了 0.8B 的推理循环，并在没有梯度或训练的情况下使数学能力最高提升 6 倍，甚至使指令遵循能力提升 3 倍。我们将其称为“权重空间编程”：前沿 LLM 现在能够原生读取和写入神经网络权重。

items.abstract_or_text: We are sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life. Vault particles are a longstanding mystery. They are barrel-shaped objects, among the largest protein structures found in our cells. They were first discovered by Leonard Rome and Nancy Kedersha in 1986, but their function remains unknown. With Claude, we have found results that might bring us closer to solving that mystery. Until now, vaults were only known in the cells of complex things like animals and plants. We have shown that similar proteins from bacteria (and the viruses that infect them) can also assemble into vaults. Finding the structures in these simpler forms of life may make it easier to investigate their function in our own cells. For our life sciences team, the project was also a demonstration of the potential (and the limitations) of using AI to accelerate science.
items.summary_zh: 事实：Anthropic 表示，其生物学研究团队与 Claude 合作，解析了细菌来源 vault 颗粒的首个三维结构，并发现细菌及其感染病毒也能组装出类似 vault 的结构。

items.abstract_zh: 我们正在分享生物学研究团队如何与 Claude 合作，绘制出细菌生命中的一种 vault 颗粒的首个三维结构。Vault 颗粒是长期存在的谜题。它们是桶状结构，是我们细胞中发现的最大的蛋白质结构之一。它们于 1986 年由 Leonard Rome 和 Nancy Kedersha 首次发现，但其功能仍然未知。借助 Claude，我们取得了可能让我们更接近解决这一谜题的结果。直到现在，人们只知道复杂生物（如动物和植物）的细胞中存在 vault。我们证明，来自细菌（以及感染细菌的病毒）的类似蛋白质也能组装成 vault。在这些更简单的生命形式中发现这些结构，可能使研究它们在我们自身细胞中的功能变得更容易。对我们的生命科学团队而言，这个项目也展示了使用 AI 加速科学的潜力和局限性。

items.abstract_or_text: Scaling laws depend on a metric that improves gradually with scale in order to extrapolate to a large target scale. We are interested in the accuracy metric, but you might get zero accuracy for small models. You cannot extrapolate from a bunch of zeros. Key idea: introduce a hint level, and fit a joint scaling law Accuracy(scale, hint).
items.summary_zh: 作者观点：Percy Liang 说明，规模法则需要一个随规模逐步改善的指标；当小模型准确率为零时，无法直接外推，因此提出引入 hint level，并拟合联合规模法则 Accuracy(scale, hint)。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这为低规模、零准确率区间的规模法则外推指出了明确的统计建模问题和可能解法；帖文是研究思路摘要，尚非完整方法或结果。
items.abstract_zh: 规模法则依赖于一个会随规模逐步改善的指标，以便外推到更大的目标规模。我们关注准确率指标，但小模型可能得到零准确率。你无法从一堆零值进行外推。关键想法是引入一个提示级别（hint level），并拟合联合规模法则 Accuracy(scale, hint)。
items.author_line: Percy Liang
